scope: synthetic CPU only, no patient loader or queue integration
candidate: train-only weighted prototype clustering on a prespecified observed descriptor subspace, per-cluster patient-mean PCA and train-median binary target
not_claimed: no generic biological identification or task utility guarantee; descriptor/content subspaces are structural assumptions
fit: 3 seeded k-means++ initializations, at most 50 Lloyd steps, training inertia selection only; patient-equal token weights; per-cluster PCA unscaled content means
frozen: centers, standardizer, PCA axes, content means and thresholds never refit on heldout data

gate.rule: Only separated_informative is a positive feasibility gate. Other cases are required failure/limitation controls, not reasons to tune PCA or claim task-aware targets.

planned_neural_followup_if_gate_passes.settings: same ContentBudgetSlotSurvival, width16, K4/modal, private4, common4, Adam .003, batch32, content1, budget cap1 nat/slot weight.3, all-slot mean readout
planned_neural_followup_if_gate_passes.selection: fixed last step; no architecture/hyperparameter selection on these exploratory tests; 5 stochastic forward evaluations per model are not new trainings
planned_neural_followup_if_gate_passes.utility_control: latent risk always uses original informative role amplitudes; in nuisance condition dominant within-role variance is independent of risk
planned_neural_followup_if_gate_passes.oracle_control: oracle type-to-learned-prototype permutation is fitted on training rows only for this upper-bound arm and diagnostic scoring; frozen_content never uses latent roles or outcomes
